subject: Request: New telemetry subprocessor (EdgePayload) — security & contract items
messages:
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme-corp.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@acme-corp.com
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New telemetry subprocessor — quick clarification

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the heads-up earlier. Our security and legal teams reviewed the one-line note about EdgePayload. Before we proceed with the procurement request, can you confirm:

- Whether EdgePayload will receive any plaintext customer data or only metadata/telemetry?
- Where EdgePayload is hosted (country / AWS regions) and whether data will transit through the US?
- Whether Redwood has executed a DPA addendum that names EdgePayload as a subprocessor (we need a signed copy or a DocuSign link).

If you can share the latest subprocessor roster and any SOC2/KMS attestations, that would help us fast-track the vendor approval. We'll aim to get procurement sign-off within 7 business days if everything checks out.

Appreciate it — Sarah
Sarah Lopez
Head of Platform Security, Acme Corporation

---
Attachments: none
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New telemetry subprocessor — quick clarification

Hi Sarah,

Thanks — I pulled together the details below and attached the roster + draft DPA addendum for your review. Quick summary:

- Data type: EdgePayload will only receive telemetry and anonymized request metadata. No customer prompt text or PII is sent to them. We classify the data as "operational telemetry" in the DPA.
- Hosting/regions: EdgePayload runs in AWS us-east-1 and eu-west-1. We do not route telemetry through on-prem or third-party US regions beyond those AZs.
- DPA addendum: Draft attached (DPA_addendum_draft_v1.pdf). We will push the signed addendum to DocuSign when legal signs off; sharing the draft now for acme legal feedback.
- Evidence: SOC2 type II report and current KMS scope are available; I included a link in the related links section.

Proposed onboarding timeline (tentative):
1) This week: Acme legal + security review DPA draft and roster.
2) Next week: Redwood legal issues DocuSign; signs and returns.
3) Week after: EdgePayload onboarding completes (tech contact and limited telemetry test).

Marissa / Ben — FYI, this is the account we expect to convert to a reserved tier in Q4. Sarah is asking if we can shorten the procurement window; can we commit to a 5-business-day turnaround on the DocuSign step if legal asks for minor redlines?

Markus Klein
Director, Product Security — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx; DPA_addendum_draft_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme-corp.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New telemetry subprocessor — quick clarification

Hi Sarah — thanks for the checklist. Two quick notes from the commercial side:

- Procurement: If Acme can confirm the telemetry-only scope in writing (one paragraph acknowledgement), we can include a short subprocessor addendum clause in the master DPA to speed sign-off. Happy to draft that acknowledgement language for you.
- Timeline: Ben, can your team scope the technical onboarding window? We promised Acme an internal trial for their engineering team; if the DPA signs this week we want to start the trial by 24 Jul.

Markus — we can also offer a temporary retention carve-out (30-day rollback window) if Acme legal needs us to limit data persistence during the pilot. Sarah, would that help?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the thorough response, team. A couple of follow-ups from Acme security/legal after internal review:

- Confirmation needed in writing that EdgePayload will not receive request or prompt content under any pilot configuration. We need a one-paragraph attestation to attach to our procurement ticket.
- SOC2: please share the last full SOC2 report via secure link (not as email attachment). We will request a short access window.
- KMS jurisdiction: Acme requires that any keys used to encrypt telemetry at rest remain in the EU for EU-region telemetry. Can you confirm EdgePayload supports EU-only KMS (we saw eu-west-1 but need confirmation they will not import keys in us-east-1 for EU workload)?

If you can provide the attestation and the secure links by end of day Thu, 17 Jul, procurement can approve the pilot and we can start the engineering trial the week of 21 Jul. Otherwise procurement will need an additional review cycle.

Thanks — Sarah
